name: lingora-web
description: Learner boundary and web application for Lingora.

scripts.build: npm --prefix .. run db:product:generate -w lingora-admin && node scripts/prepare-prisma-runtime.mjs && next build
scripts.test:feature: node --experimental-strip-types --experimental-test-module-mocks --import ./tests/feature/harness/server-only.mjs --test tests/feature/auth.test.mjs tests/feature/context.test.mjs tests/feature/login-flow.test.mjs tests/feature/review-regressions.test.mjs tests/feature/session-transport.test.mjs tests/feature/prisma-runtime.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:feature && npm run test:components
